rules: For a single episode of otitis media with effusion lasting less than 3 months, do not recommend tympanostomy tube placement under the OME indication.
Bilateral tympanostomy tubes may be offered for bilateral OME that has persisted for at least 3 months when hearing difficulties are documented.

Recurrent acute otitis media meets the episode threshold when there are at least 3 episodes in 6 months or at least 4 episodes in 12 months, including at least 1 episode in the preceding 6 months; tubes may be offered under this indication only when middle-ear effusion is present in at least one ear at candidacy assessment.
